title: Table 2.3b Car parking provisions for development outside of the Perth and Peel regions (occupant minimum spaces per dwelling, R40 and below)

rows.note: studio and 1 bedroom; second column (R50+ 'maximum garage and carport') prints 1

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Value = 'Minimum parking space(s) for R40 and below (per dwelling)', same as Chapter 2. The printed table has further parts carried as rule thresholds: (1) ancillary dwelling row: minimum 1 (rule C2.3.5-r1); second column 0 (C2.3.5-r3). (2) second column headed 'Maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above (per dwelling)': studio/1 bed 1, 2 bed 1, 3+ bed 1 (rule C2.3.5-r2). HEADER PROBLEM (register ch3-030): the values look like a transposed Location B minimum row; encoded literally with verify true; no R50+ minimum stated. (3) Visitor car parking (rule C2.3.7): 0-4 dwellings no visitor parking required; 5+ dwellings 0.15 bays per dwelling for the total number of dwellings, rounded to the nearest whole number with 0.5 or greater rounded up. No Location A/B outside Perth and Peel. C2.9.1(ii) small dwelling parking cites Table 2.3a only.

verified.note: Page 20 prints Table 2.3b with columns headed 'Minimum parking space(s) for R40 and below (per dwelling)' (1 / 1 / 2 / 2) and 'Maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above (per dwelling)' (0 / 1 / 1 / 1) for ancillary / studio-1 bed / 2 bed / 3+ bed. The headings are not transposed; the second column reads like minimums under a 'maximum' heading and caps a 3+ bedroom dwelling below the R40-and-below minimum. Encoded as printed.
